thread:
maria (CSM): Quick draft — proposing a short 'Go‑Live Seatbelt' checklist we can share with customers when they're moving to livemode or spiking traffic. Focus: cache prefill, request batching, streaming fallbacks, and renewal risk signals. TL;DR at bottom.

ashley (Field Ops): love it. Can we make it one page + one email snippet to send to customers? Keep ops steps very prescriptive.

devon (Solutions Eng): +1. Also add a small snippet to validate client-side backoff and retry headers so they don't accidentally retry into a storm.

maria (CSM): Yes — I'll draft. Thinking sections: preflight checks, prefill checklist, batching config, streaming best practices, telemetry to watch, escalation steps.

sam (Support): Heads up — last week a customer had stale KV cache after deploy. Maybe include a 'cache invalidation' quick command and when to contact us. Also include 'how to confirm model fallback' logs.

ashley (Field Ops): here's a quick prefilling step we use internally:
```
# Prefill warm cache (example)
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill
{ "tenant_id": "ACME-123", "examples": ["top prompts..."], "ttl": 86400 }
```
Note: prefills are advisory; they don't guarantee warm KV on cold GPUs but reduce initial tail latency.

devon (Solutions Eng): For batching, suggest these knobs:
- target_batch_size: 8–16 for chat workloads
- max_wait_ms: 8–30ms depending on latency SLO
Add example config: `batch { target: 12 max_wait_ms: 20 }` and a note about throughput vs latency tradeoff.

maria (CSM): Streaming advice: encourage clients to enable chunked streaming for UIs, and provide a fallback route using a smaller model variant when token budget spikes. Example guidance we can give customers: stream=true, fallback_model: redwood-small when latency > 500ms.

sam (Support): Add a short telemetry list customers should share during escalations: 1) request id, 2) route + model version, 3) raw prompt (redact PII), 4) timestamps for client/server, 5) streaming error payloads.

eng-bot: deploy started: doc/cs/go-live-seatbelt-v0.1 -> staging (sha: 9f2a3b) :rocket:

maria (CSM): Draft of the customer-facing one-pager (first pass) — feel free to edit: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Go-Live+Seatbelt+v0.1 (internal link).

ashley (Field Ops): Can we include a short renewal-risk trigger box? e.g., if 3+ production incidents in 14 days or sustained 2x latency vs baseline -> flag AE and SE to prioritize.

maria (CSM): Good call. I'll add thresholds and the playbook for 'Immediate AE+SE sync' (15‑min slot) and 'Customer health pulse' email template.

devon (Solutions Eng): One more technical flag: advise customers to enable KV prefixing for multi-tenant prompts so cache hit rate isn't polluted across users. Small code hint: `kv_prefix = tenant_id[:8]`.

maria (CSM): Final checklist (to be converted to one-pager + email):
- Preflight: confirm model version & route pinned, baseline latency/throughput captured
- Prefill: run prefill API with representative prompts (QA -> staging -> prod order)
- Cache ops: include invalidation command and expected TTLs; verify KV prefixing
- Batching: recommend target_batch_size & max_wait_ms with examples for chat vs. completion
- Streaming: enable chunked stream + fallback_model setting; confirm client handles partial responses
- Telemetry: collect request_id, model, timestamps, and streaming errors for any support ticket
- Escalation: 15-min AE+SE sync if >3 incidents in 14 days or sustained 2x latency vs baseline

sam (Support): I'll add two short support templates: 'Info request' and 'Urgent triage' that customers can paste into a ticket. Makes life much faster.

maria (CSM): Thanks all — I'll iterate and push to staging. Intend to share with customer success leads tomorrow morning. If anyone has brief wording suggestions for the email snippet, drop them here by EOD. :white_check_mark:

ashley (Field Ops): Suggestion for email subject: "Pre-Go‑Live checklist: small steps to avoid cold latency and incident triage". Short body + attachments.

devon (Solutions Eng): One-liner for the tech appendix: "If you see tail latency > 2x baseline after prefill, enable fallback_model and open a support ticket with request_id + timeline."

maria (CSM): Perfect. I'll wrap up and ping again once the staging doc is published. Thanks! :sparkles:
